changelog:
1.2.0 — Events that include CfOC leadership or Senior Research Fellows (current or past) are highlighted with a ★ “With CfOC” line, sort first in the calendar, and can be filtered with the “With CfOC people” checkbox. Editors can add people in the event sidebar.

1.1.1 — Suggestions are never discarded by the spam check (browser autofill could trigger it); flagged ones arrive in Pending with "possible spam" in the email subject.

1.1.0 — Events from the feed publish automatically; ones not yet confirmed by the organizer show a “Dates unconfirmed” tag. Suggestion emails include a one-click approve link. Plugin now updates itself from GitHub.
